alternative_notation.dimension_formula: osp(2m|2n) with m=1, even = 2n^2 + n + 1, odd = 4n

basis.ordering_convention: PBW: kappa < [odd: E_eps1_del{k}_pp/pm/mp/mm] < [even: H_k, E_2del{k}_p/m, E_del{i}_del{j}_pp/mm/pm/mp] (K = 1 is excluded)

linear_map_f.description: Odd linear map f: g -> g reversing parity (p(f(X)) = 1 - p(X))

coboundary.description: Coboundary operator (delta f)(X, Y) = (-1)^p(X) [X, f(Y)] - (-1)^{(p(X)+1)p(Y)} [Y, f(X)] - f([X, Y])
